notes.notes:
[img]http://www.awfullynicestudios.com/NEVERDELETE/TheBugButcher/harryWorkingOnPlan.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added Spanish language (thanks to Efrén)
[*] Fixed leaderboard problems
[*] Fixed health issues in coop
[*] Fixed spawning problem with gold bug in coop
[*] Custom Ctrls menu now only has Save option as "back" did the same thing
[*] If you are a linux user please use this command to fix Spawning problem from enemies http://steamcommunity.com/app/350740/discussions/0/458606877319585574/
[/list]

notes.title: Release bug fixes
notes.notes:
We had an incredible launch day. But with all that fun also a few bugs came along. 
Here are the first few bugs that should be fixed:

[list]
[*] Retry button should work now properly
[*] Added xInput controller support
[*] Leaderboards were a bit broken when you haven't played a level yet
[*] The highest combo number shouldn't be a huge number anymore (if it is plesae let us know. It is working on our side)
[/list]

We are on the achievements problem next, get spanish translation fixed and will have russian language support soon.

notes.title: Update 3.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.awfullynicestudios.com/NEVERDELETE/TheBugButcher/mainCapsule.jpg[/img]

We are super excited to FINALLY release the panic mode to the public. Alongside many bugfixes here are the main features that got added:
- local coop Panic Mode
- Single Panic Mode
- Dash button can be held down now for skating around
- New Protective Bubble powerup in Panic mode
- separate leaderboards for single and multiplayer

This is quite a big update for us. We hope we smoothed out most of the bugs. If you find something please hit us up. ENJOY! ;)

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
[b]Update 1.2 is here!!!![/b]
We are super excited to introduce the dash feature in this update and FINALLY supporting Linux as well.
BTW.... you can dash through frozen enemies now. ;)

[img]http://goo.gl/VQgi9d[/img]

Here is a summary of what has been updated:
[list]
[*]Added new Dash feature
[*]Added Linux Support
[*]Added Windows 10 Support
[*]CMD + TAB and windowed mode support for MAC
[*]Added indicators on Floor 2 Energy Walls.
[*]Added Volume Controls
[*]and like always... exterminated lots of disgusting bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0 just went live
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It took a moment but our first update is finally here! Get ready to sweat your ass off as you battle the blazing bugs of the Steelworks floor.  Encounter 3 new enemy types while you dodge your way around a giant steel hammer whose only ambition in life is to smash your puny bones into thin meat pancake. 

The update also includes ton fixes and updates of which we listed the most significant below.  We hope you enjoy the new content!

•	Floor 4 is now unlocked!!!
•	Flickering on “End Round” menu removed
•	Weapon powerups are based off ammunition and not time anymore
•	Enemies now spawn during freeze grenade effect
•	Harry can now hit frozen enemies closer to the ground
•	Elevator fire no longer does damage during freeze grenade effect
•	Adjusted all enemy hit boxes for reduced frustration :)
•	Difficulty reduced on easy and medium
•	The strange “floaty” behavior after bouncing off walls was removed for
several enemies
•	Combo bug where it would stop adding up was removed
•	Updated a bunch of enemy art and weapon effects. 
•	Health bubble bug where it failed to despawn after pick up has been removed
•	Leaderboards now show all players 
•	Bug where harry would randomly keep running without input has been removed.
•	Buffed Gatling Gun with a  bit more power
•	Floor 2 divider walls now require less time to pull down.
•	Tons of little bugs were smashed!
